"use client";
import type { ChartData } from "../lib/types";

export default function ChartRenderer({ chart, width = 300, height = 160 }: { chart: ChartData; width?: number; height?: number }) {
  const data = chart.data || [];
  if (data.length === 0) return <div className="text-xs opacity-50">無資料</div>;

  const isHorizontal = chart.orientation === "horizontal";
  const type = chart.type;
  const variant = chart.variant || "single";

  // Helpers
  const maxValue = Math.max(...data.map((d) => d.value), 1);
  const colors = ["#3b82f6", "#10b981", "#f59e0b", "#ef4444", "#8b5cf6", "#06b6d4"];

  // Grouped data helper
  const groupByLabel = () => {
    const map = new Map<string, { label: string; values: { series: string; value: number }[] }>();
    data.forEach((d) => {
      const label = d.label;
      if (!map.has(label)) map.set(label, { label, values: [] });
      map.get(label)!.values.push({ series: d.series || "預設", value: d.value });
    });
    return Array.from(map.values());
  };

  // --- BAR CHARTS ---
  if (type === "bar") {
    if (variant === "grouped") {
      const groups = groupByLabel();
      const seriesSet = Array.from(new Set(data.map((d) => d.series || "預設")));
      return (
        <div className="w-full" style={{ height }}>
          <div className={`flex ${isHorizontal ? "flex-col" : "flex-row"} items-end gap-2 h-full`}>
            {groups.map((g, gi) => (
              <div key={gi} className={`flex ${isHorizontal ? "flex-col" : "flex-row"} gap-1 flex-1`}>
                {g.values.map((v, vi) => (
                  <div key={vi} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 flex-1">
                    <div className="w-full rounded-t" style={{ backgroundColor: colors[vi % colors.length], height: isHorizontal ? "12px" : `${Math.max(6, (v.value / maxValue) * (height - 40))}px`, width: isHorizontal ? `${Math.max(6, (v.value / maxValue) * 100)}%` : "100%" }} title={`${v.series}: ${v.value}`} />
                    {!isHorizontal && <span className="text-[8px] truncate">{g.label}</span>}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1 flex-wrap">
            {Array.from(new Set(data.map((d) => d.series || "預設"))).map((s, i) => (
              <span key={s} className="text-[9px] flex items-center gap-1"><span className="w-2 h-2 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: colors[i % colors.length] }} />{s}</span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (variant === "stacked" || variant === "stacked-percent") {
      const groups = groupByLabel();
      return (
        <div className="w-full flex flex-col gap-2" style={{ height }}>
          {groups.map((g, gi) => {
            const total = g.values.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v.value, 0);
            return (
              <div key={gi} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] w-12 truncate">{g.label}</span>
                <div className={`flex ${isHorizontal ? "flex-row" : "flex-row"} flex-1 h-4 rounded overflow-hidden border`}>
                  {g.values.map((v, vi) => {
                    const percent = variant === "stacked-percent" ? (total ? (v.value / total) * 100 : 0) : (v.value / maxValue) * 100;
                    const widthPercent = variant === "stacked-percent" ? percent : (v.value / Math.max(...groups.map((gg) => gg.values.reduce((s, vv) => s + vv.value, 0)), 1)) * 100;
                    return <div key={vi} style={{ width: `${widthPercent}%`, backgroundColor: colors[vi % colors.length] }} title={`${v.series}: ${v.value}${variant === "stacked-percent" ? ` (${percent.toFixed(1)}%)` : ""}`} />;
                  })}
                </div>
                <span className="text-[9px] opacity-60">{variant === "stacked-percent" ? "100%" : total}</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      );
    }
    // single / category
    return (
      <div className={`w-full flex ${isHorizontal ? "flex-col" : "flex-row items-end"} gap-2`} style={{ height }}>
        {data.map((d, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={`flex ${isHorizontal ? "flex-row items-center" : "flex-col items-center"} gap-1 flex-1`}>
            {isHorizontal ? (
              <>
                <span className="text-[10px] w-12 truncate text-right">{d.label}</span>
                <div className="h-4 rounded" style={{ width: `${Math.max(4, (d.value / maxValue) * 100)}%`, backgroundColor: colors[i % colors.length] }} title={`${d.value}`} />
                <span className="text-[9px] opacity-60">{d.value}</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="w-full rounded-t" style={{ height: `${Math.max(6, (d.value / maxValue) * (height - 30))}px`, backgroundColor: colors[i % colors.length] }} title={`${d.value}`} />
                <span className="text-[9px] truncate max-w-full">{d.label}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // --- LINE CHART ---
  if (type === "line") {
    const points = data.map((d, i) => {
      const x = (i / Math.max(data.length - 1, 1)) * (width - 40) + 20;
      const y = height - 30 - (d.value / maxValue) * (height - 50);
      return `${x},${y}`;
    }).join(" ");
    return (
      <svg width={width} height={height} className="overflow-visible">
        <polyline fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" strokeWidth="2" points={points} />
        {data.map((d, i) => {
          const x = (i / Math.max(data.length - 1, 1)) * (width - 40) + 20;
          const y = height - 30 - (d.value / maxValue) * (height - 50);
          return <circle key={i} cx={x} cy={y} r={3} fill="#3b82f6" />;
        })}
      </svg>
    );
  }

  // --- PIE / DONUT ---
  if (type === "pie" || type === "donut") {
    const total = data.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0) || 1;
    const segments = data.reduce<{ datum: typeof data[number]; index: number; startAngle: number; endAngle: number }[]>((items, datum, index) => {
      const startAngle = items[index - 1]?.endAngle || 0;
      const endAngle = startAngle + (datum.value / total) * 360;
      items.push({ datum, index, startAngle, endAngle });
      return items;
    }, []);
    const cx = width / 2;
    const cy = height / 2;
    const r = Math.min(width, height) / 2 - 10;
    const innerR = type === "donut" ? r * 0.5 : 0;

    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <svg width={width} height={height} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}>
          {segments.map(({ datum: d, index: i, startAngle, endAngle }) => {
            const angle = endAngle - startAngle;
            const largeArc = angle > 180 ? 1 : 0;
            const x1 = cx + r * Math.cos((Math.PI * startAngle) / 180);
            const y1 = cy + r * Math.sin((Math.PI * startAngle) / 180);
            const x2 = cx + r * Math.cos((Math.PI * endAngle) / 180);
            const y2 = cy + r * Math.sin((Math.PI * endAngle) / 180);
            const x3 = cx + innerR * Math.cos((Math.PI * endAngle) / 180);
            const y3 = cy + innerR * Math.sin((Math.PI * endAngle) / 180);
            const x4 = cx + innerR * Math.cos((Math.PI * startAngle) / 180);
            const y4 = cy + innerR * Math.sin((Math.PI * startAngle) / 180);
            const path = innerR > 0
              ? `M ${x1} ${y1} A ${r} ${r} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${x2} ${y2} L ${x3} ${y3} A ${innerR} ${innerR} 0 ${largeArc} 0 ${x4} ${y4} Z`
              : `M ${cx} ${cy} L ${x1} ${y1} A ${r} ${r} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${x2} ${y2} Z`;
            return <path key={i} d={path} fill={colors[i % colors.length]} stroke="white" strokeWidth={1} />;
          })}
        </svg>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          {data.map((d, i) => (
            <span key={i} className="text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1"><span className="w-2 h-2 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: colors[i % colors.length] }} />{d.label}: {d.value}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // --- PYRAMID ---
  if (type === "pyramid") {
    return (
      <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center gap-1" style={{ height }}>
        {data.map((d, i) => {
          const wPercent = 100 - (i / data.length) * 60;
          return (
            <div key={i} className="flex items-center justify-center text-white text-[10px] transition-all" style={{ width: `${wPercent}%`, height: `${height / data.length - 4}px`, backgroundColor: colors[i % colors.length], clipPath: "polygon(10% 0, 90% 0, 100% 100%, 0% 100%)" }} title={`${d.label}: ${d.value}`}>
              {d.label}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // --- GANTT ---
  if (type === "gantt") {
    const maxEnd = Math.max(...data.map((d) => d.end || d.value), 1);
    return (
      <div className="w-full space-y-2" style={{ height }}>
        {data.map((d, i) => {
          const start = d.start || 0;
          const end = d.end || d.value;
          const left = (start / maxEnd) * 100;
          const widthBar = ((end - start) / maxEnd) * 100;
          return (
            <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px]">
              <span className="w-16 truncate">{d.label}</span>
              <div className="flex-1 h-4 bg-zinc-100 rounded relative overflow-hidden">
                <div className="absolute h-full rounded" style={{ left: `${left}%`, width: `${widthBar}%`, backgroundColor: colors[i % colors.length] }} />
              </div>
              <span className="opacity-60">{d.start}→{d.end}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // --- RADAR ---
  if (type === "radar") {
    const cx = width / 2;
    const cy = height / 2;
    const r = Math.min(width, height) / 2 - 20;
    const angleStep = (2 * Math.PI) / data.length;
    const points = data.map((d, i) => {
      const angle = i * angleStep - Math.PI / 2;
      const dist = (d.value / maxValue) * r;
      const x = cx + dist * Math.cos(angle);
      const y = cy + dist * Math.sin(angle);
      return `${x},${y}`;
    }).join(" ");
    return (
      <svg width={width} height={height}>
        {/* Grid */}
        {[0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((scale, idx) => (
          <polygon key={idx} points={data.map((_, i) => {
            const angle = i * angleStep - Math.PI / 2;
            const x = cx + r * scale * Math.cos(angle);
            const y = cy + r * scale * Math.sin(angle);
            return `${x},${y}`;
          }).join(" ")} fill="none" stroke="#e5e7eb" strokeWidth={0.5} />
        ))}
        {/* Axes */}
        {data.map((_, i) => {
          const angle = i * angleStep - Math.PI / 2;
          const x = cx + r * Math.cos(angle);
          const y = cy + r * Math.sin(angle);
          return <line key={i} x1={cx} y1={cy} x2={x} y2={y} stroke="#e5e7eb" strokeWidth={0.5} />;
        })}
        <polygon points={points} fill="rgba(59,130,246,0.3)" stroke="#3b82f6" strokeWidth={2} />
        {data.map((d, i) => {
          const angle = i * angleStep - Math.PI / 2;
          const x = cx + (r + 12) * Math.cos(angle);
          const y = cy + (r + 12) * Math.sin(angle);
          return <text key={i} x={x} y={y} fontSize={9} textAnchor="middle" dominantBaseline="middle">{d.label}</text>;
        })}
      </svg>
    );
  }

  // --- TIMELINE (文字圖表：時間軸) ---
  if (type === "timeline") {
    return (
      <div className="w-full flex flex-col gap-2 relative" style={{ height }}>
        <div className="absolute left-3 top-0 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-300" />
        {data.map((d, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="flex gap-3 items-start relative">
            <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-500 border-2 border-white shadow flex items-center justify-center text-[8px] text-white shrink-0 z-10">{i+1}</div>
            <div className="flex-1 bg-white border rounded p-2 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-xs font-medium">{d.label}</div>
              <div className="text-[10px] opacity-60">{d.value ? `值：${d.value}` : ""} {d.series || ""}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // --- TEXT COLUMNS ---
  if (type === "text-columns") {
    const mid = Math.ceil(data.length / 2);
    const left = data.slice(0, mid);
    const right = data.slice(mid);
    return (
      <div className="w-full grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs" style={{ height }}>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {left.map((d, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="border rounded p-2 bg-white">
              <div className="font-medium">{d.label}</div>
              <div className="opacity-60 text-[10px]">{d.value} {d.series || ""}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {right.map((d, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="border rounded p-2 bg-white">
              <div className="font-medium">{d.label}</div>
              <div className="opacity-60 text-[10px]">{d.value} {d.series || ""}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // --- TEXT LIST / QUOTE ---
  if (type === "text-list" || type === "text-quote") {
    return (
      <div className="w-full space-y-2" style={{ height }}>
        {data.map((d, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={`border rounded p-2 ${type === "text-quote" ? "bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 italic" : "bg-white"}`}>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-2"><span>{type === "text-quote" ? "❝" : "•"}</span>{d.label}</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] opacity-60 mt-1">{d.value ? `— ${d.value}` : ""} {d.series || ""}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <div className="text-xs opacity-50">未支援的圖表類型: {type}</div>;
}

"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";

const COMMON_COLORS: string[] = [
  "#000000", "#434343", "#666666", "#999999", "#b7b7b7", "#cccccc", "#d9d9d9", "#efefef", "#f3f3f3", "#ffffff",
  "#980000", "#ff0000", "#ff9900", "#ffff00", "#00ff00", "#00ffff", "#4a86e8", "#0000ff", "#9900ff", "#ff00ff",
  "#e6b8af", "#f4cccc", "#fce5cd", "#fff2cc", "#d9ead3", "#d0e0e3", "#c9daf8", "#cfe2f3", "#d9d2e9", "#ead1dc",
  "#dd7e6b", "#ea9999", "#f9cb9c", "#ffe599", "#b6d7a8", "#a2c4c9", "#a4c2f4", "#9fc5e8", "#b4a7d6", "#d5a6bd",
  "#cc4125", "#e06666", "#f6b26b", "#ffd966", "#93c47d", "#76a5af", "#6d9eeb", "#6fa8dc", "#8e7cc3", "#c27ba0",
];

const STORAGE_KEY = "nexus-recent-colors";
const MAX_RECENT = 10;

function getRecentColors(): string[] {
  try {
    const raw: string | null = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? (parsed as string[]).slice(0, MAX_RECENT) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveRecentColor(color: string): void {
  try {
    const recent: string[] = getRecentColors().filter((c: string) => c.toLowerCase() !== color.toLowerCase());
    recent.unshift(color);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(recent.slice(0, MAX_RECENT)));
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

interface ColorPaletteButtonProps {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  currentColor: string;
  onColorChange: (color: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [recentColors, setRecentColors] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const popupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) setRecentColors(getRecentColors());
  }, [isOpen]);

  const updatePosition = useCallback(() => {
    if (!buttonRef.current) return;
    const rect = buttonRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    let left = rect.left;
    let top = rect.bottom + 8;
    // clamp to viewport
    const popupWidth = 248;
    if (left + popupWidth > window.innerWidth - 8) {
      left = window.innerWidth - popupWidth - 8;
    }
    if (top + 320 > window.innerHeight - 8) {
      top = rect.top - 320 - 8;
      if (top < 8) top = 8;
    }
    setPos({ top, left });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    updatePosition();
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node;
      if (buttonRef.current && buttonRef.current.contains(target)) return;
      if (popupRef.current && popupRef.current.contains(target)) return;
      setIsOpen(false);
    };
    const handleResize = () => updatePosition();
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);

    handleSelect(e.target.value);

  return (

        ref={buttonRef}

        style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}
      >

      </button>

      {mounted && isOpen && createPortal(

          onMouseDown={(e: React.MouseEvent) => e.preventDefault()}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 pb-2" style={{ borderBottom: "1px solid var(--color-border)" }}>
            <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded border" style={{ backgroundColor: currentColor || "transparent", borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }} />

            <button onClick={handleClear} className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-zinc-200 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100">Clear</button>
          </div>
          <div className="mb-2">

                    boxShadow: color.toLowerCase() === (currentColor || "").toLowerCase() ? "0 0 0 1px #2563eb" : "none",
                  }}

            </div>

            <div className="mb-2">

"use client";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { Page } from "../lib/types";
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";

export interface CommandPaletteAction { id: string; label: string; icon: string; keywords?: string; run: () => void; }

export default function CommandPalette({ isOpen, onClose, pages, actions, onSelectPage }: {
  isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; pages: Page[]; actions: CommandPaletteAction[]; onSelectPage: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => { if (isOpen) { setQuery(""); setActiveIndex(0); setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 0); } }, [isOpen]);

  const filteredActions = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return actions;
    return actions.filter((a) => a.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (a.keywords || "").toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [actions, query]);

  const filteredPages = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const sorted = [...pages].sort((a, b) => b.updated_at - a.updated_at);
    if (!q) return sorted.slice(0, 8);
    return sorted.filter((p) => (p.title || t("common.untitled")).toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0, 20);
  }, [pages, query, t]);

  type ListItem = { type: "action"; action: CommandPaletteAction } | { type: "page"; page: Page };
  const items: ListItem[] = useMemo(() => [
    ...filteredActions.map((action) => ({ type: "action" as const, action })),
    ...filteredPages.map((page) => ({ type: "page" as const, page })),
  ], [filteredActions, filteredPages]);

  useEffect(() => { setActiveIndex(0); }, [query]);
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const runItem = (item: ListItem) => {
    if (item.type === "action") item.action.run();
    else onSelectPage(item.page.id);
    onClose();
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); onClose(); return; }
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); setActiveIndex((prev) => Math.min(prev + 1, Math.max(items.length - 1, 0))); return; }
    if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); setActiveIndex((prev) => Math.max(prev - 1, 0)); return; }
    if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); const item = items[activeIndex]; if (item) runItem(item); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[1000] flex items-start justify-center pt-[12vh]" style={{ backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)" }} onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl" style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-bg)", border: "1px solid var(--color-border)" }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }}>
          <span className="opacity-40 text-sm">🔍</span>
          <input ref={inputRef} type="text" value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={handleKeyDown} placeholder={t("commandPalette.placeholder")} className="w-full bg-transparent outline-none text-sm" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }} />
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-xs opacity-40 hover:opacity-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ border: "1px solid var(--color-border)" }}>{t("commandPalette.esc")}</button>
        </div>
        <div className="max-h-[360px] overflow-y-auto p-1.5">
          {items.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-sm text-center py-8 opacity-40" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{t("commandPalette.noResults")}</div>
          ) : (<>
            {filteredActions.length > 0 && <div className="px-2 pt-1.5 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400 uppercase">{t("commandPalette.actions")}</div>}
            {filteredActions.map((action, index) => (
              <button key={action.id} onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)} onClick={() => runItem({ type: "action", action })} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-md text-sm text-left transition-all" style={{ backgroundColor: index === activeIndex ? "var(--color-border)" : "transparent", color: "var(--color-text)" }}>
                <span>{action.icon}</span><span className="truncate">{action.label}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
            {filteredPages.length > 0 && <div className="px-2 pt-2.5 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400 uppercase">{t("commandPalette.pages")}</div>}
            {filteredPages.map((page, index) => {
              const gi = filteredActions.length + index;
              const pageIcon = page.kind === "study_set" ? "🗂️" : page.kind === "document" ? "📄" : page.primary_attachment_id ? "📑" : "📝";
              return (
                <button key={page.id} onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(gi)} onClick={() => runItem({ type: "page", page })} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-md text-sm text-left transition-all" style={{ backgroundColor: gi === activeIndex ? "var(--color-border)" : "transparent", color: "var(--color-text)" }}>
                  <span>{pageIcon}</span><span className="truncate">{page.title || t("common.untitled")}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </>)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import { isCreativeCharacterPage, type Page } from "../lib/types";
import CharacterTemplateManager from "./CharacterTemplateManager";
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";

// 書本封面主題配色庫
const BOOK_COVER_THEMES = [
  { bg: "linear-gradient(145deg, #1e1b4b 0%, #312e81 60%, #4338ca 100%)", border: "#4338ca", accent: "#fbbf24", spine: "#17143a" },
  { bg: "linear-gradient(145deg, #450a0a 0%, #7f1d1d 60%, #991b1b 100%)", border: "#991b1b", accent: "#fef08a", spine: "#310505" },
  { bg: "linear-gradient(145deg, #064e3b 0%, #065f46 60%, #047857 100%)", border: "#047857", accent: "#a7f3d0", spine: "#033427" },
  { bg: "linear-gradient(145deg, #18181b 0%, #27272a 60%, #3f3f46 100%)", border: "#3f3f46", accent: "#e4e4e7", spine: "#09090b" },
  { bg: "linear-gradient(145deg, #4c1d95 0%, #6d28d9 60%, #7c3aed 100%)", border: "#7c3aed", accent: "#fbcfe8", spine: "#37146e" },
  { bg: "linear-gradient(145deg, #451a03 0%, #78350f 60%, #92400e 100%)", border: "#92400e", accent: "#fde68a", spine: "#2e1001" },
];

function getNovelStats(page: Page) {
  const text = page.content_text || "";
  const chineseChars = (text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g) || []).length;
  const englishWords = (text.match(/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g) || []).length;
  const totalCount = chineseChars + englishWords;

  const doc = (page.content_json as any) || { content: [] };
  let chapterCount = 0;
  function countHeadings(node: any) {
    if (!node) return;
    if (node.type === "heading" && (node.attrs?.level === 1 || node.attrs?.level === 2)) {
      chapterCount++;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(node.content)) node.content.forEach(countHeadings);
  }
  countHeadings(doc);

  return { totalCount, chapterCount: Math.max(chapterCount, 1) };
}

export default function CreativeView({
  pages,
  onCreateCharacter,
  onCreateWorld,
  onSelectPage,
  onDeletePage,
  templates = [],
  onCreateTemplate,
  onRenameTemplate,
}: {
  pages: Page[];
  onCreateCharacter: (templateId?: string) => void;
  templates?: Page[];
  onCreateTemplate: () => void;
  onRenameTemplate: (id: string, title: string) => void;
  onCreateWorld: () => void;
  onSelectPage: (id: string) => void;
  onDeletePage?: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [charModalOpen, setCharModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [templateManagerOpen, setTemplateManagerOpen] = useState(false);

  // Windows 總管三種檢視模式：圖示 (icons)、清單 (list)、詳細資料 (details)
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<"icons" | "list" | "details">("icons");

  // 詳細資料模式排序狀態
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<"title" | "type" | "size" | "updated_at" | "created_at">("updated_at");
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<"asc" | "desc">("desc");

  useEffect(() => {
    const savedMode = localStorage.getItem("nexus_creative_view_mode") as "icons" | "list" | "details" | null;
    if (savedMode === "icons" || savedMode === "list" || savedMode === "details") {
      setViewMode(savedMode);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleSetViewMode = (mode: "icons" | "list" | "details") => {
    setViewMode(mode);
    localStorage.setItem("nexus_creative_view_mode", mode);
  };

  const creativePages = useMemo(() => {
    // 小說有專屬入口；創作工作台只管理角色與創作素材。
    return pages.filter((p) => !p.deleted_at && !p.character_data?.isTemplate && isCreativeCharacterPage(p));
  }, [pages]);

  const characterPages = useMemo(() => {
    return creativePages;
  }, [creativePages]);

  const displayedPages = useMemo(() => {
    const baseList = creativePages;

    return [...baseList].sort((a, b) => {
      let cmp = 0;
      if (sortField === "title") {
        cmp = (a.title || "").localeCompare(b.title || "");
      } else if (sortField === "type") {
        const aType = a.creative_type || (a.character_data ? "character" : "novel");
        const bType = b.creative_type || (b.character_data ? "character" : "novel");
        cmp = aType.localeCompare(bType);
      } else if (sortField === "size") {
        const aSize = (a.content_text || "").length;
        const bSize = (b.content_text || "").length;
        cmp = aSize - bSize;
      } else if (sortField === "created_at") {
        cmp = (a.created_at || 0) - (b.created_at || 0);
      } else {
        cmp = (a.updated_at || 0) - (b.updated_at || 0);
      }
      return sortOrder === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
    });
  }, [creativePages, sortField, sortOrder]);

  const toggleSort = (field: "title" | "type" | "size" | "updated_at" | "created_at") => {
    if (sortField === field) {

  };

  return (
    <main className="flex flex-col flex-1 overflow-y-auto" style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-editor-bg)" }}>

      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[960px] p-6 sm:p-10 space-y-8">
        {/* 標題與簡介 */}
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>
            <span>✍️</span>
            <span>{t("sidebar.nav.creative")} 工作台</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">管理世界觀、角色檔案與創作素材；小說請從獨立的「小說」功能進入。</p>
        </div>

        <button onClick={() => setTemplateManagerOpen(true)} className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-2 text-sm" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)", color: "var(--color-text)" }}>模板管理</button>
        {/* 快速新增區塊 */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">

          <button

            style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-bg)", borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }}
          >

                🎭

              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 bg-indigo-100/60 dark:bg-indigo-900/40 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">

                結構化角色檔案、外貌心理、自訂屬性數值條、人際關係與履歷卡
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t text-xs font-semibold text-blue-600 flex items-center gap-1" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }}>

          </button>
          <button onClick={onCreateWorld} className="group rounded-2xl border p-5 text-left hover:shadow-lg transition-all" style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-bg)", borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }}>
            <div className="text-base font-bold group-hover:text-blue-600">建立世界觀</div>
            <div className="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed opacity-60">以相同的區塊式資料頁整理世界設定、地點、歷史與規則。</div>

                >

                  style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }}
                >
                  <div><div className="font-bold text-sm group-hover:text-blue-600">CoC 7e 調查員模板</div><div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-0.5">調查員資料、專業能力與履歷欄位</div></div>

"use client";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { isNovelPage, type Page, type PageFormat } from "../lib/types";
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import NewPageDialog, { type NewPageKindChoice } from "./NewPageDialog";

export default function Dashboard({ pages, onSelectPage, onCreatePage, onCreateDocument, onCreateStudySet, onCreatePresentation, onImportPdf, onDeletePages, onPinPages, onReorderPages, onSetFolder, onRefresh }: {
  pages: Page[]; onSelectPage: (id: string) => void; onCreatePage: (format: PageFormat) => void;
  onCreateDocument: (format: PageFormat) => void; onCreateStudySet: () => void; onCreatePresentation?: (format: PageFormat) => void; onImportPdf: () => void;
  onDeletePages: (ids: string[]) => void; onPinPages: (ids: string[]) => void; onReorderPages: (orderedIds: string[]) => void;
  onSetFolder: (ids: string[], folder: string | null) => void; onRefresh: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isNewPageDialogOpen, setIsNewPageDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<"list" | "grid">("list");
  const [sortMode, setSortMode] = useState<"updated" | "custom">("updated");
  const [folderFilter, setFolderFilter] = useState("all");
  const [isSelecting, setIsSelecting] = useState(false);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [openedAt] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const topLevelPages = pages.filter((p) => !p.parent_id);
  const folders = useMemo(() => [...new Set(topLevelPages.map((page) => page.folder?.trim() || "未分類"))].sort(), [topLevelPages]);
  const folderGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const filtered = folderFilter === "all" ? topLevelPages : topLevelPages.filter((page) => (page.folder?.trim() || "未分類") === folderFilter);
    const sorted = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
      const aPinned = (a.sort_order ?? 0) < 0;
      const bPinned = (b.sort_order ?? 0) < 0;
      if (aPinned !== bPinned) return aPinned ? -1 : 1;
      return sortMode === "updated" ? b.updated_at - a.updated_at : (a.sort_order ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) - (b.sort_order ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    });
    const groups = new Map<string, Page[]>();
    sorted.forEach((page) => {
      const folder = page.folder?.trim() || "未分類";
      groups.set(folder, [...(groups.get(folder) || []), page]);
    });
    return [...groups.entries()].map(([name, items]) => ({ name, items }));
  }, [topLevelPages, sortMode, folderFilter]);

  const visiblePages = useMemo(() => folderGroups.flatMap((group) => group.items), [folderGroups]);
  const allSelectedPinned = selectedIds.size > 0 && [...selectedIds].every((id) => (pages.find((page) => page.id === id)?.sort_order ?? 0) < 0);
  const toggleSelection = (id: string) => setSelectedIds((previous) => {
    const next = new Set(previous); if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id); else next.add(id); return next;
  });
  const finishSelection = () => { setIsSelecting(false); setSelectedIds(new Set()); };
  const movePage = (id: string, direction: -1 | 1) => {
    const ids = visiblePages.map((page) => page.id); const index = ids.indexOf(id); const target = index + direction;
    if (index < 0 || target < 0 || target >= ids.length) return;
    [ids[index], ids[target]] = [ids[target], ids[index]]; onReorderPages(ids);
  };
  const refresh = async () => { if (isRefreshing) return; setIsRefreshing(true); try { await onRefresh(); } finally { setIsRefreshing(false); } };

  const formatRelativeTime = (ts: number): string => {
    const diffMs = openedAt - ts;
    const diffMinutes = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
    if (diffMinutes < 1) return t("time.justNow");
    if (diffMinutes < 60) return t("time.minutesAgo", { n: diffMinutes });
    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMinutes / 60);
    if (diffHours < 24) return t("time.hoursAgo", { n: diffHours });
    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHours / 24);
    if (diffDays < 7) return t("time.daysAgo", { n: diffDays });
    return new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const handleConfirmNewPage = (kind: NewPageKindChoice, format: PageFormat) => {
    if (kind === "document") onCreateDocument(format);
    else if (kind === "note") onCreatePage(format);
    else if (kind === "presentation") onCreatePresentation?.(format);
    else onCreateStudySet();
  };

  const pageIcon = (page: Page) => {
    if (page.kind === "study_set") return "🗂️";
    if (page.kind === "document") return "📄";
    if (page.kind === "presentation") return "📊";
    if (page.primary_attachment_id) return "📑";
    return "📝";
  };

  const pageKindLabel = (page: Page) => {
    if (page.kind === "study_set") return "字卡";
    if (page.kind === "document") return "文檔";
    if (page.kind === "presentation") return "簡報";
    if (page.kind === "quick_note") return "隨手記";
    if (page.kind === "todo") return "日曆";
    if (page.kind === "creative") return isNovelPage(page) ? "小說" : "創作";
    if (page.primary_attachment_id) return "PDF 研究";
    return "筆記";
  };

  return (
    <main data-pull-refresh className="relative flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain touch-pan-y" style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-editor-bg)" }}>
      <div className="flex min-h-full w-full flex-col mx-auto" style={{ maxWidth: "820px", padding: "48px 64px" }}>
        <div className="mb-1 text-sm opacity-60" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{t("dashboard.home")}</div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold mb-6" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{t("dashboard.welcome")}</h1>
        <div className="mb-8">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">{t("dashboard.quickCreate")}</div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <button onClick={() => setIsNewPageDialogOpen(true)} className="rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition-all hover:opacity-90" style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-text)", color: "var(--color-bg)" }}>➕ {t("dashboard.newButton")}</button>
            <button onClick={onImportPdf} className="rounded-md px-3.5 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-all hover:bg-zinc-200" style={{ border: "1px solid var(--color-border)", color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{t("dashboard.importPdf")}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <section>
          <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400">{t("dashboard.recent")}</div><button type="button" onClick={() => void refresh()} disabled={isRefreshing} className="rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-sm leading-none opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 disabled:opacity-35" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }} title="重新整理" aria-label="重新整理">↻</button></div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border p-1" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }} aria-label="首頁顯示與排列方式">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" aria-label="顯示方式">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setViewMode("list")} className="rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-sm hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" style={{ backgroundColor: viewMode === "list" ? "var(--color-border)" : "transparent" }} title="清單顯示" aria-label="清單顯示">☷</button>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setViewMode("grid")} className="rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-sm hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" style={{ backgroundColor: viewMode === "grid" ? "var(--color-border)" : "transparent" }} title="格狀顯示" aria-label="格狀顯示">▦</button>
              </div>
              <span className="h-4 w-px" style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-border)" }} />
              <select value={sortMode} onChange={(event) => setSortMode(event.target.value as "updated" | "custom")} className="bg-transparent px-1.5 py-1 text-xs outline-none" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }} aria-label="排列方式">
                <option value="updated">最近編輯</option>
                <option value="custom">自訂順序</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <select value={folderFilter} onChange={(event) => setFolderFilter(event.target.value)} className="rounded-md border bg-transparent px-2 py-1.5 text-xs" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)", color: "var(--color-text)" }} aria-label="資料夾篩選">
              <option value="all">全部資料夾</option>{folders.map((folder) => <option key={folder} value={folder}>{folder}</option>)}
            </select>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => isSelecting ? finishSelection() : setIsSelecting(true)} className="rounded-md border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)", color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{isSelecting ? "完成" : "選取檔案"}</button>
            {isSelecting && <span className="text-xs opacity-60">已選 {selectedIds.size} 項</span>}
          </div>
          {isSelecting && selectedIds.size > 0 && (
            <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border p-2" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)", backgroundColor: "var(--color-bg)" }}>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => onPinPages([...selectedIds])} className="rounded-md border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }}>📌 {allSelectedPinned ? "取消置頂" : "置頂"}</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => { const name = window.prompt("資料夾名稱（留白代表未分類）", ""); if (name !== null) onSetFolder([...selectedIds], name.trim() || null); }} className="rounded-md border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }}>📁 分類</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => { if (window.confirm(`將 ${selectedIds.size} 個檔案移至垃圾桶？`)) { onDeletePages([...selectedIds]); finishSelection(); } }} className="rounded-md border border-red-200 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-red-600">移至垃圾桶</button>
            </div>

          ) : (

              {folderGroups.map(({ name, items }) => (

                  <div className={viewMode === "grid" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2" : "space-y-1"}>

"flex min-h-24 items-start rounded-xl border p-3 transition-all hover:bg-zinc-200/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60" : "flex w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-all hover:bg-zinc-200/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"} style={{ color: "var(--color-text)", borderColor: viewMode === "grid" ? "var(--color-border)" : "transparent" }}>

## File: src/components/DocumentRuler.tsx
````
import type { PageFormat, PageMargins } from "../lib/types";
import { DEFAULT_PAGE_MARGINS } from "../lib/types";

type RulerDimensions = { widthMm: number; width: string };

const PX_PER_MM = 3.779527559;
const FLOW_CONTENT_MARGIN_MM = 64 / PX_PER_MM;

function getRulerDimensions(format: PageFormat): RulerDimensions {
  if (format === "a4" || format === "paged") return { widthMm: 210, width: "794px" };
  if (format === "16:9") return { widthMm: 960 / PX_PER_MM, width: "960px" };
  if (format === "4:3") return { widthMm: 800 / PX_PER_MM, width: "800px" };
  return { widthMm: 820 / PX_PER_MM, width: "820px" };
}

export function getDocumentRulerWidth(format: PageFormat): string {
  return getRulerDimensions(format).width;
}

export default function DocumentRuler({
  format,
  margins,
}: {
  format: PageFormat;
  margins?: PageMargins;
}) {
  const { widthMm } = getRulerDimensions(format);
  const activeMargins = margins || (format === "flow"
    ? { ...DEFAULT_PAGE_MARGINS, left: FLOW_CONTENT_MARGIN_MM, right: FLOW_CONTENT_MARGIN_MM }
    : DEFAULT_PAGE_MARGINS);
  const ticks = Array.from({ length: Math.floor(widthMm) + 1 }, (_, millimeter) => millimeter);
  const labels = ticks.filter((millimeter) => millimeter % 10 === 0);
  const finalLabel = labels[labels.length - 1];
  const leftMargin = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (activeMargins.left / widthMm) * 100));
  const rightMargin = Math.min(100 - leftMargin, Math.max(0, (activeMargins.right / widthMm) * 100));

  return (
    <div
      role="img"
      aria-label={`水平尺規；左右灰色區域表示頁面邊界，目前左邊界 ${activeMargins.left} mm、右邊界 ${activeMargins.right} mm`}
      className="relative h-7 w-full select-none overflow-hidden border-y"
      style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-bg)", borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }}
    >
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0" style={{ width: `${leftMargin}%`, backgroundColor: "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.22)" }} />
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0" style={{ width: `${rightMargin}%`, backgroundColor: "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.22)" }} />

      {ticks.map((millimeter) => {
        const isCentimeter = millimeter % 10 === 0;
        const isHalfCentimeter = millimeter % 5 === 0;
        return (
          <span
            key={millimeter}
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="absolute bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-500/60"
            style={{
              left: `${(millimeter / widthMm) * 100}%`,
              height: isCentimeter ? "10px" : isHalfCentimeter ? "7px" : "4px",
            }}
          />
        );
      })}
      {labels.map((millimeter) => (
        <span
          key={`label-${millimeter}`}
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`absolute top-0.5 text-[9px] tabular-nums opacity-60 ${millimeter === 0 ? "translate-x-0" : millimeter === finalLabel ? "-translate-x-full" : "-translate-x-1/2"}`}
          style={{ left: millimeter === 0 ? "2px" : millimeter === finalLabel ? "calc(100% - 2px)" : `${(millimeter / widthMm) * 100}%`, color: "var(--color-text)" }}
        >
          {millimeter / 10}
        </span>
      ))}

      <span aria-hidden="true" title={`左邊界：${activeMargins.left} mm`} className="absolute top-2 -translate-x-1/2 text-[10px] leading-none text-blue-600" style={{ left: `${leftMargin}%` }}>▼</span>
      <span aria-hidden="true" title={`右邊界：${activeMargins.right} mm`} className="absolute top-2 -translate-x-1/2 text-[10px] leading-none text-blue-600" style={{ left: `${100 - rightMargin}%` }}>▼</span>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import type { Page } from "../lib/types";

export default function FeatureOverview({
  title,
  description,
  icon,
  actionLabel,
  pages,
  onCreate,
  onSelectPage,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon: string;
  actionLabel: string;
  pages: Page[];
  onCreate: () => void;
  onSelectPage: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const orderedPages = [...pages].sort((a, b) => b.updated_at - a.updated_at);

  return (
    <main data-pull-refresh className="flex flex-1 overflow-y-auto" style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-editor-bg)" }}>
      <section className="mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl px-6 py-10 sm:px-10">
        <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="mb-2 text-3xl">{icon}</div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{title}</h1>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm opacity-60" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{description}</p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onCreate} className="rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-white shadow-sm transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5" style={{ backgroundColor: "#1a73e8" }}>
            + {actionLabel}
          </button>
        </div>

        {orderedPages.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed px-6 py-16 text-center text-sm opacity-55" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)", color: "var(--color-text)" }}>
            尚未建立任何項目
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {orderedPages.map((page) => (
              <button key={page.id} type="button" onClick={() => onSelectPage(page.id)} className="rounded-2xl border p-4 text-left transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md" style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-bg)", borderColor: "var(--color-border)", color: "var(--color-text)" }}>
                <div className="mb-6 text-xl">{icon}</div>
                <div className="truncate font-medium">{page.title || "未命名"}</div>
                <div className="mt-1 text-xs opacity-50">最近編輯於 {new Date(page.updated_at).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import type { PageFormat } from "../lib/types";
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";

export default function FileMenu({
  currentFormat,
  isDocument,
  isPresentation = false,
  onFormatChange,
  onExportMarkdown,
  onExportPdf,
  onExportNexus,
  onPrint,
  onNewNote,
  onNewDocument,
  onImportPdf,
  onImportMd,
  onConvertToPresentation,
  onDeleteBlankPages,
}: {
  currentFormat: PageFormat;
  isDocument: boolean;
  isPresentation?: boolean;
  onFormatChange?: (f: PageFormat) => void;
  onExportMarkdown?: () => void;
  onExportPdf?: () => void;
  onExportNexus?: () => void;
  onPrint?: () => void;
  onNewNote?: () => void;
  onNewDocument?: () => void;
  onImportPdf?: () => void;
  onImportMd?: () => void;
  onConvertToPresentation?: () => void;
  onDeleteBlankPages?: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const popupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [pos, setPos] = useState<{ top: number; left: number }>({ top: 0, left: 0 });
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []);

  const updatePos = useCallback(() => {
    if (!buttonRef.current) return;
    const rect = buttonRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    let left = rect.left;
    let top = rect.bottom + 6;
    const w = 272;
    if (left + w > window.innerWidth - 8) left = window.innerWidth - w - 8;
    if (top + 520 > window.innerHeight - 8) {
      top = rect.top - 520 - 6;
      if (top < 8) top = 8;
    }
    setPos({ top, left });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    updatePos();
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node;
      if (buttonRef.current && buttonRef.current.contains(target)) return;
      if (popupRef.current && popupRef.current.contains(target)) return;
      setIsOpen(false);
    };
    const onResize = () => updatePos();
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onResize, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onResize, true);
    };
  }, [isOpen, updatePos]);

  const fmt = currentFormat || "flow";
  // 2026-08-11：分頁/流動不可轉換。簡報保留 16:9/4:3 切換；其餘只顯示目前模式。

  return (
    <>
      <button
        ref={buttonRef}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((v) => !v)}
        className="flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded px-2 py-1 text-[13px] transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-200/70"
        style={{ border: "none", color: "var(--color-text)", backgroundColor: isOpen ? "rgba(0,0,0,0.07)" : "transparent" }}
        title="檔案選單"
      >
        <span>{t("file.title")}</span>
        <span className="text-[9px] opacity-40">▾</span>
      </button>

      {mounted && isOpen && createPortal(
        <div
          ref={popupRef}
          className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl z-[9999] max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto"
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            top: pos.top,
            left: pos.left,
            width: 272,
            backgroundColor: "var(--color-bg)",
            border: "1px solid var(--color-border)",
          }}
          onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        >
          <div className="px-3 pt-2.5 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400 uppercase">新建</div>
          <button onClick={() => { onNewNote?.(); setIsOpen(false); }} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-left hover:bg-zinc-100" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}><span>📝</span> 新建筆記 (流動預設)</button>
          <button onClick={() => { onNewDocument?.(); setIsOpen(false); }} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-left hover:bg-zinc-100" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}><span>📄</span> 新建文檔 (A4預設)</button>

          <div className="my-1 border-t" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }} />
          <div className="px-3 pt-1 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400 uppercase">匯入</div>
          <button onClick={() => { onImportPdf?.(); setIsOpen(false); }} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-left hover:bg-zinc-100" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}><span>📥</span> 匯入 PDF</button>
          <button onClick={() => { onImportMd?.(); setIsOpen(false); }} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-left hover:bg-zinc-100" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}><span>📄</span> 匯入 Markdown → 文檔</button>

          <div className="my-1 border-t" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }} />
          <div className="px-3 pt-1 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400 uppercase">簡報</div>

"use client";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import type { PageFormat, PageKind } from "../lib/types";

export type NewPageKindChoice = PageKind;
// 2026-08-11：建立流程
// - 筆記：選「流動 / 分頁」兩種模式（建立後不可轉換）
// - 文檔：一律流動（直接建立）
// - 學習集：直接建立（flow）
// - 簡報：選 16:9 / 4:3
const FORMAT_OPTIONS_BY_KIND: Record<string, PageFormat[]> = {
  presentation: ["16:9", "4:3"],
};
const NOTE_MODE_OPTIONS: { value: PageFormat; icon: string }[] = [
  { value: "flow", icon: "📄" },
  { value: "paged", icon: "📑" },
];
const DEFAULT_FORMAT_BY_KIND: Record<string, PageFormat> = {
  document: "flow",
  study_set: "flow",
};

export default function NewPageDialog({ isOpen, onClose, onConfirm, initialKind }: {
  isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; onConfirm: (kind: NewPageKindChoice, format: PageFormat) => void;
  initialKind?: PageKind | null;
}) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<"kind" | "noteMode" | "format">("kind");
  const [selectedKind, setSelectedKind] = useState<NewPageKindChoice | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && initialKind) {
      if (initialKind === "note") {
        setSelectedKind(initialKind);
        setStep("noteMode");
      } else if (initialKind === "study_set") {
        onConfirm(initialKind, "flow");
        onClose();
      } else if (initialKind === "presentation") {
        setSelectedKind(initialKind);
        setStep("format");
      } else {
        // document：直接建立（一律流動）
        onConfirm(initialKind, DEFAULT_FORMAT_BY_KIND[initialKind] || "flow");
        onClose();
      }
    } else if (isOpen) {
      setStep("kind");
      setSelectedKind(null);
    }
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isOpen, initialKind]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const kindOptions = [
    { id: "document" as const, icon: "📄", label: t("newPage.kind.document"), desc: t("newPage.kind.document.desc") },
    { id: "note" as const, icon: "📝", label: t("newPage.kind.note"), desc: t("newPage.kind.note.desc") },
    { id: "study_set" as const, icon: "🗂️", label: t("newPage.kind.studySet"), desc: t("newPage.kind.studySet.desc") },
    { id: "presentation" as const, icon: "📊", label: "簡報", desc: "投影片：圖表/版面/示圖/目錄" },
  ];

  const formatLabel = (f: PageFormat) => {
    if (f === "flow") return t("newPage.format.flow");
    if (f === "paged") return t("newPage.format.paged");
    if (f === "a4") return t("newPage.format.a4");
    if (f === "16:9") return t("newPage.format.169");
    if (f === "4:3") return t("newPage.format.43");
    return t("newPage.format.custom");
  };

  const handleSelectKind = (kind: NewPageKindChoice) => {
    if (kind === "note") {
      setSelectedKind(kind);
      setStep("noteMode");
      return;
    }
    if (kind === "study_set") { onConfirm(kind, "flow"); handleClose(); return; }
    if (kind === "presentation") {
      setSelectedKind(kind);
      setStep("format");
      return;
    }
    // document：不選格式，一律流動
    onConfirm(kind, DEFAULT_FORMAT_BY_KIND[kind] || "flow");
    handleClose();
  };

  const handleSelectNoteMode = (format: PageFormat) => {
    if (!selectedKind) return;
    onConfirm(selectedKind, format);
    handleClose();
  };
  const handleSelectFormat = (format: PageFormat) => {
    if (!selectedKind) return;
    onConfirm(selectedKind, format);
    handleClose();
  };
  const handleClose = () => { setStep("kind"); setSelectedKind(null); onClose(); };

  const showKindStep = step === "kind" && !initialKind;
  const showNoteModeStep = step === "noteMode" && selectedKind === "note";
  const showFormatStep = step === "format" && selectedKind === "presentation";

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[1000] flex items-center justify-center" style={{ backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)" }} onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) handleClose(); }}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl" style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-bg)", border: "1px solid var(--color-border)" }}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-b" style={{ borderColor: "var(--color-border)" }}>
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>
            {showFormatStep ? t("newPage.formatTitle") : showNoteModeStep ? t("newPage.noteModeTitle") : t("newPage.title")}
          </span>
          <button onClick={handleClose} className="text-sm opacity-40 hover:opacity-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ border: "1px solid var(--color-border)" }}>{t("commandPalette.esc")}</button>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 space-y-2">
          {showKindStep && kindOptions.map((option) => (
            <button key={option.id} onClick={() => handleSelectKind(option.id)} className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-left transition-all hover:bg-zinc-100" style={{ border: "1px solid var(--color-border)" }}>
              <span className="text-2xl">{option.icon}</span>
              <span><span className="block text-sm font-medium" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{option.label}</span><span className="block text-xs opacity-60" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{option.desc}</span></span>
            </button>
          ))}
          {showNoteModeStep && NOTE_MODE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
            <button key={option.value} onClick={() => handleSelectNoteMode(option.value)} className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-left transition-all hover:bg-zinc-100" style={{ border: "1px solid var(--color-border)" }}>
              <span className="text-2xl">{option.icon}</span>
              <span>
                <span className="block text-sm font-medium" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>{formatLabel(option.value)}</span>
                <span className="block text-xs opacity-60" style={{ color: "var(--color-text)" }}>
                  {option.value === "flow" ? t("newPage.noteMode.flowDesc") : t("newPage.noteMode.pagedDesc")}
                </span>
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
          {showFormatStep && (FORMAT_OPTIONS_BY_KIND[selectedKind as string] || ["flow"]).map((format) => (
            <button key={format} onClick={() => handleSelectFormat(format)} className="w-full flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-left transition-all hover:bg-zinc-100" style={{ border: "1px solid var(--color-border)", color: "var(--color-text)" }}>
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">{formatLabel(format as PageFormat)}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
